query:
The Ridgeline Runners have a consistent expectation about what follows a longer Sunday run. Does this expectation hold for every member? What in the conversation shows otherwise, and for whom?

Options:
A. Leo
B. Nadia
C. Rafe
D. Yuki
context:
[1] (about=Nadia, episodic, t8 @2025-10-05T11:35:00) I HAVE been waiting to deliver it, I won't lie 😂 Rafe you always go straight to the pub after long runs and every time you cramp on anything over 12km. I've been watching this pattern for months. You need electrolytes and food before any alcohol, it's just physiology
[2] (about=Nadia, episodic, t10 @2025-10-12T10:30:00) Okay pub after? This is a proper post-long-run Sunday and I think we've all earned it 🍺 right? Who's in?
[3] (about=Cass, core, t2 @2025-09-14T09:46:00) Wants to do more regular runs beyond one Sunday a month.
[4] (about=Cass, core, t14 @2025-10-26T12:31:00) Ran Harrogate Half Marathon in 2:06:51; very happy.
[5] (about=Leo, core, t6 @2025-09-28T11:01:00) Will consider Harrogate Half Marathon; needs to assess schedule in November.
[6] (about=Leo, core, t14 @2025-10-26T12:31:00) Ran Harrogate Half Marathon in 2:01:44; hamstring held; completed full post-race stretch protocol.
[7] (about=Nadia, core, t14 @2025-10-26T12:31:00) Wants to plan winter running schedule next week; suggests longer training runs through November.
[8] (about=Rafe, core, t2 @2025-09-14T09:46:00) Enjoys long Sunday runs followed by something substantial at the pub as a reward.
[9] (about=Rafe, core, t14 @2025-10-26T12:31:00) Post-race plan should involve proper Sunday lunch with beer garden; earned after standing in field.
[10] (about=Tom, core, t14 @2025-10-26T12:31:00) Ran Harrogate Half Marathon in 1:51:12; negative split worked, second half 3 minutes faster than first.
[11] (about=Tom, core, t12 @2025-10-19T09:31:00) Taper week: easy runs only, legs need to be fresh.
[12] (about=Yuki, episodic, t10 @2025-10-12T10:22:00) That is consistent with the research on pacing strategy. Negative splits outperform even-effort by approximately 2-4% in recreational runners.
agent_answer:
No — the expectation does **not** hold for every member.

The conversation specifically ties the post-long-Sunday-run pub pattern to **Rafe**. Nadia says:

> “Rafe you always go straight to the pub after long runs and every time you cramp on anything over 12km.”

So the person for whom the conversation shows this otherwise is **C. Rafe**. Leo, Nadia, and Yuki are not shown as having that same pub-after-long-run expectation.
